title: Projective Ore-Degree Conditions for Intersection Theorems in Vector Spaces
summary: Let $V$ be an $n$-dimensional vector space over the finite field $\mathbb F_q$, and let $\mathcal F\subsetneq\genfrac{[}{]}{0pt}{}{V}{k}$. The \emph{projective Ore-degree} of $\mathcal F$ is the minimum, over all $k$-subspaces $S\notin\mathcal F$, of the sum of the $\mathcal F$-degrees of the projective points contained in $S$. We prove sharp projective Ore analogues of the vector-space Erdős--Ko--Rado and Hilton--Milner theorems.
